how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: WCD Odisha Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download WCD Odisha Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts is 02 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper positions by WCD Odisha.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly Online through the official WCD Odisha website.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Anganwadi Worker and Helper are on a Contractual basis.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the official notification for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed via the "Official Notification PDF" link in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q7. What are the specific post names for the vacancies?
faq.answer: The specific post names for the vacancies are Kalakar and Sahayak.

faq.question: Q8. Does WCD Odisha offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation is not explicitly provided in the extracted data. Please refer to the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for WCD Odisha recruitment is https://online.engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only. Offline applications will not be accepted.
